description: Report TopicForge environment state as a `HealthReport`: `mode`, `ros_backend`, `dds_backend`, `ros_tools_available`, `ros2_distro`, `rmw_implementation`, `dds_domain_id` and `observed_domain_note` (only the domain joined at startup is observed), server version and sample cap; for a live DDS backend also `observer_started_ns` / `now_ns` (nothing earlier was watched) and the discovery tracker status `tracker_*` (errors, evictions or a stale pass mean gaps). `live` with `ros_backend` `none` is a DDS-only setup: use `list_endpoints`. With `dds_backend` `none`, `dds_inactive_note` says why. `payload_decoding` is `disabled` (DDS user-topic payloads are not decoded); `dds_security` is `not_supported`. **Always succeeds**: call it first when something looks wrong. Read-only; no side effects. **Duration**: never waits for a lock and never runs the `ros2` CLI; it answers at once.
name: health_check

outputSchema.description: Result of `health_check`. Always succeeds, even when the host is unhealthy.

contract_version.description: Output contract version; changes when a field is renamed, removed or retyped.

dds_backend.description: DDS backend serving: `mock`, `cyclone`, `fast`, or `none` (DDS module inactive).

dds_domain_id.description: DDS domain id observed when the DDS module is active.

dds_inactive_note.description: Why `dds_backend` is `none` while ROS 2 serves; else `null`.

dds_security.description: DDS Security is not handled: protected endpoints and data are invisible.

max_sample_count.description: Server cap on samples per call; larger requests are clamped.

middleware_available.description: True when a DDS backend serves; else whether the configured binding is importable.

mode.description: Mode serving: `mock` or `live` (`live` with `ros_backend` `none`: DDS tools only); may differ from `requested_mode` after a fallback.

now_ns.description: Server wall-clock time (ns since epoch) when this report was built.

observed_domain_note.description: Which DDS domain is observed: only the one joined at startup; others are invisible.

observer_started_ns.description: ns when the DDS observer joined; nothing earlier was watched. `None` without one.

payload_decoding.description: `disabled`: DDS user-topic payloads are not decoded.

ros2_available.description: Whether a `ros2` CLI is on PATH.

ros2_distro.description: `ROS_DISTRO` if set (disclosed by design under the local-trust model).

ros_security_enabled.description: `ROS_SECURITY_ENABLE` is `true`; `None` unless the ros2 CLI serves.

ros_security_keystore_set.description: Whether a keystore variable is set (the path is never shown).

ros_security_strategy.description: `ROS_SECURITY_STRATEGY` when set to a valid value.

ros_tools_available.description: True when the ROS 2 tools can run (`ros_backend` is not `none`); on a DDS-only setup use `list_endpoints`.

sim_clock_published.description: Whether `/clock` had a publisher at the last graph read (stamps may be sim time); `None` in mock or without a recent read.

tracker_cache_evictions.description: Discovery entries dropped from a full tracker cache; non-zero means the bus is bigger than listed.

tracker_errors.description: Tracker passes that raised; non-zero means gaps.

tracker_last_pass_ns.description: ns of the last tracker pass; far older than `now_ns` means stale lifecycle.

tracker_passes.description: Completed discovery tracker passes since start.

tracker_running.description: Whether the discovery tracker thread is alive (Cyclone); `None` without a tracker.

outputSchema.title: HealthReport

title: Health check
